answer: The Ember Cartographer uses a trellis of reputation beacons where each new identity must stake a cryptographic token that is periodically challenged by a random raven‑selected verifier. Successively earned proof of work multiplies the stake weight quadratically, so ten fresh IDs together contribute less than a single long‑standing node. An attacker must therefore acquire and continuously renew a quadratic‑scaled stake, costing resources exponential to the number of Sybil nodes he wishes to field.
